notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
The following changes have been made.
【Bug fixes】
● Entering matchmaking for Private Battle after entering certain commands would cause the game to freeze.

We look forward to your continued support for "LogiKing".

notes.title: "LogiKing" is officially out now
notes.content:
LogiKing has officially been released!
Play LogiKing now and find out who is the true King of Logic!

※ Thank you for purchasing the early access.
We are working on the issues laid out in everyone's feedback.
Thank you all! We truly appreciate all of the feedback!
